title: Afterdeath
description: Die as a human, rise as a zombie - fight through infection stages, craft a cure, or steal bodies in PvP.
body: # Afterdeath (Zombie Player & Infection System) _(v0.5.5)_ _JEI is highly recommended for recipe info_ **Only v0.4.5+ are fully compatible and stable with OptiFine.** ## [**Bug Reports & Feature Requests**](https://github.com/Murzik344/Afterdeath-Issues/issues) ## [**Official Afterdeath Discord Server**](https://discord.gg/y5UXessNGT) ## [**What's new in the mod**](https://modrinth.com/mod/afterdeath/changelog) ## Core Mechanic ![a player fighting zombies and turning into a zombie](https://i.ibb.co/k2gbQhKY/getting-infected.gif) When you die, you rise again as a **zombie player**. Your inventory drops, your abilities change, and you must find a way to cure yourself - or embrace the undead life. ## Infection System * Getting hit by zombies or cave spiders gradually **infects** you. * Infection progresses through **3 stages** with increasing debuffs. * **Dynamic HUD:** A custom on-screen progress bar and fullscreen tint will visually track your exact infection percentage. * At 100% (Infection Stage III), you **transform into a zombie player**. * **[NEW!]** Entering Infected Water or standing on infected blocks will now actively inflict Poison and Nausea. * You can eat **Totem Shards** or **Golden Apples** to reduce infection. * Beware of **Infected Water** and **over 450 new Infected Block variants** spreading through the environment. * **The Gas Zombie:** A dangerous hostile zombie variant that spits toxic projectiles, leaves lingering infected gas clouds upon death, and strictly guards Graveyards and Infected Lakes. - **[NEW!]** Submerging vanilla mobs in Infected Water for 15 seconds will now cause them to violently shake and mutate into their undead variants: - *Zombies > Drowned* - *Husks > Zombies* - *Villagers > Zombie Villagers* - *Piglins > Zombified Piglins* - *Horses > Zombie Horses* ## Rusty Iron Equipment ![Rusty iron items](https://i.ibb.co/S7BfRsbH/rusty-iron-stuff-0-5-5.jpg) Toss vanilla iron items into **Infected Water** to create the new **Rusty Iron** set (Armor, Tools, Shears, Blocks, Buckets, Doors, Trapdoors, Bars, Horse Armor, **[NEW!]:** **Shields, Lanterns, and Chains**). * Rusty tools inflict Poison on mobs and Infection on players. Rusty Armor acts like Thorns, infecting attackers (but it slowly infects the wearer too). * **[NEW!]** Rusty Armor and Tools can now be fully repaired in an anvil using Rusty Iron Ingots. (The new Rusty Shield, which fully supports Banner Patterns, is repaired with Infected Planks). * **[NEW!]** Rusty Horse Armor now provides the exact same Thorns (infection/poison) counter-attack effect as player Rusty Armor. * Harvesting any infected block in Survival mode strictly requires using the correct matching Rusty Iron tool. * Slaying a Gas Zombie specifically with a Rusty tool completely prevents it from releasing its toxic gas cloud. * Rusty Buckets instantly convert normal water into Infected Water upon scooping. (Just don't try to scoop lava with one). ## Splash Potion of Holiness & Cleansing ![a player throwing a Splash Potion of Holiness at a patch of Infected Blocks](https://i.ibb.co/VZsncY1/curing-blockz.gif) * **Splash Potion of Holiness:** A brand new brewable item. Craft it by placing a Totem Shard and Splash Water Bottles into a Brewing Stand. * When thrown, it instantly cures infected blocks and water within a 4-block radius, fully cures players in the early infection stages, and acts as a Super Fertilizer on crops. * Hitting fully-turned Zombie or Skeleton players drops them to half a heart and applies a massive "Stun" debuff (Slowness, Weakness, and Glowing) - making them vulnerable to a Forced Cure. * Sponges can absorb Infected Water, turning into Wet Infected Sponges (which can be dried by smelting). ## Built-in World Converter ![clicking the Convert World button in the config screen, showing a progress bar, and then logging into a world to see the infection gone](https://i.ibb.co/GvTgNwC8/world-converter.gif) **Did the infection get out of hand?** Use the built-in **World Converter** directly from the mod's Config Screen. With one click, the tool will automatically create a safe backup of your save file, scan your entire world, and restore all infected blocks and water back to their normal vanilla states. ## Structures ![Graveyard and an Infected Lake](https://i.ibb.co/srJdcBp/structureslow.png) * **Infected Lake:** A highly dangerous, naturally generating source of Infected Water. (Can generate in all biomes except Mushroom Island) * **Graveyard:** Brave the dangers to find unique loot chests hidden inside ancient **Coffins**. (Can generate in all biomes except Mushroom Island) ## Zombie Forms * **Burn in sunlight** (like regular zombies). * **Night vision** in darkness. * **Hostile mobs ignore you** (before you touch them). * You cannot sprint during the day unless in darkness, rain, or thunder. * **Limited inventory** (left and right hands). * **Raw meat heals more**, cooked food is worse. * **Iron Golems & Snow Golems attack** you. (Snow golem snowballs deal 0 damage, but still knock you back). * **Villagers and Wandering Traders flee** from you. * Breathe underwater. * Killing a Villager, Horse, Piglin, or Wandering Trader will instantly convert them into their undead variant. * **Progress through 3 Zombie stages:** **Fresh > Rotting > Old Zombie**. * As you rot, you gain **massive combat resistance** against players and mobs, but become significantly **more vulnerable** to sunlight and fall damage. ## Skeleton Forms If you survive long enough as an Old Zombie, your flesh will rot away completely, turning you into a **Skeleton** (and eventually a **Wither Skeleton**) with entirely new gameplay mechanics. * Skeletons don't need to eat. Instead, you heal yourself by right-clicking with **Bones**. * You have infinite arrows and your bows/crossbows will **never** take durability damage. * Because you have no eyes, you can safely stare at Endermen without angering them. * Reach the final stage to become **100% immune to fire and lava**, inflict the Wither effect on melee hits, heal from the Wither effect, and never take sword durability damage. * **[NEW!]** Blazes are highly aggressive toward all undead players *except* Wither Skeletons, which they will treat as neutral Nether allies. ## Undead Minions & Mounts ![Left: a skeleton player riding a spider as it climbs upwards. Right: a zombie player riding a zombie horse](https://i.ibb.co/LzTnB1kc/Left-a-skeleton-player-riding-a-spider-as-it-climbs-upwards-Right-a-zombie-player-riding-a-zombie-h.gif) As a fully decomposed undead, you are a commander of the horde. * Old Zombie players can tame other zombie-type mobs using Rotten Flesh, while Wither Skeleton players can tame skeleton-type mobs using Bones. * Tamed undead will follow and defend you. Skeleton arrows will pass harmlessly through you and your other minions. *(Note: Tamed mobs automatically untame if you transition forms or are cured).* * Zombie players can tame and ride Zombie Horses using Rotten Flesh, and Skeleton players can tame and ride Skeleton Horses using Bones (A saddle is also required to ride them). * Skeleton players can tame, ride, and actually steer Spiders (and Cave Spiders, if enabled in config) to easily climb walls. ## Self Cure Ritual ![curing myself](https://i.ibb.co/FLPvYnLk/healing-myself.gif) 1. Get the **Weakness** effect (splash potion or any other item that gives a Weakness effect). 2. Eat a **Golden Apple**. 3. Eat the **Heart of Life**. ## PvP Forced Curing & Surgery Human players can now forcefully cure an undead player in combat. * **Zombie Curing:** Humans can throw a Splash Potion of Holiness to "stun" a Zombie Player, then right-click them with a Golden Apple to cure them. The newly cured player receives massive survival buffs (Regeneration II and Absorption I) to help them escape. * **Skeleton Surgery:** Once stunned with holy water, humans must right-click them with **24 Rotten Flesh** to rebuild their body limb-by-limb, before finally applying the Golden Apple. ## PvP Body Stealing ![turning other player into zombie.gif](https://i.ibb.co/SbmQ85T/infecting-another-player.gif) Zombie players can **steal the body** of living players they kill in PvP - curing themselves (by 50%) while zombifying the victim. ## Advancements & Progression A massive, fully-custom advancement tree containing **over 24 unique advancements** guides you through your undead journey. Unlock milestones for surviving as a zombie, crafting Rusty Iron gear, stealing bodies, acting as a **Field Surgeon**, raising an **Army of the Dead**, or crafting specialized survival gear. ## Sack ![The player crafts a sack and wears it](https://i.ibb.co/NdXgbwKM/The-player-crafts-a-sack-and-wears-it.gif) A unique equipment item that **expands your hotbar by 3 extra slots** when worn as a chestplate. Items persist inside the sack when unequipped. Can be crafted with 7 rabbit/normal leather and 1 string. You can use the `0`, `-` and `=` to access the extra slots quickly. The Sack can be dyed into all **16 different colors** (your items will safely transfer over when re-dyeing). ## Fully Configurable ![all mod settings](https://i.ibb.co/wvNG7pr/mod-settings.gif) Over **90 server-side options** and **15 client-side options**. Toggle every single feature, adjust damage multipliers, customize UI elements and more. * **[NEW!]** Added a built-in **Search Bar** to instantly find any setting by name, description, or value. Accessible directly from the **Vanilla Pause Menu** and right before you **Create a New World**. You can even create and assign **unique server configuration profiles for each individual world**. **Admin & Compatibility Features:** * Includes custom `//infect` and `//cure` commands (with full undo/redo support) to easily corrupt or purify massive world selections at once (only when WorldEdit is installed) * Includes `/infect`, `/cure`, `/zombie`, and `/skeleton`. ## 11 Languages _(More coming in next versions)_ * English * German * Spanish * French * Japanese * Korean * Polish * Portuguese * Russian * Ukrainian * Chinese
